name: claude-plugins-official
description: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.
one_liner: An official app-store-style catalog where you browse and install add-ons ('plugins') for Claude Code, Anthropic's AI coding tool.
buyer: A solo developer or small dev team already using Claude Code who wants vetted extensions instead of hunting GitHub for random scripts.
business_use_cases: A tooling vendor publishes their product as a listed plugin so Claude Code users discover and install it with one command.
A dev agency maintains an internal fork with only company-approved plugins, so employees can't install unvetted third-party code.
A consultant curates a 'starter pack' of plugins for new clients adopting Claude Code, cutting onboarding time.

money_ideas.idea: As a vendor, build a genuinely useful plugin and use free distribution through this marketplace to drive signups for your paid product.

steal_this: Build and submit one narrow, genuinely useful plugin (a niche integration) to get free distribution to every Claude Code user browsing the directory.
